rules.statement: A party has no right to intervene after the judgment is pronounced but before the interlocutory decree is signed in a partition action under section 70 of the Partition Act.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my view, it is not possible to argue that the intention of the Legislature in prescribing two separate acts, namely for the pronouncement of the judgment and for the entering of the interlocutory decree in accordance with the findings of that judgment, is to enable a party to intervene under section 70 of the Act after judgment is pronounced, however long it might take thereafter to draw up the decree and sign it."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 26 (1) of the Partition Act; Section 79 of the Partition Act; Section 188 of the Civil Procedure Code.
